issues.description: Wrong page displayed: URL is http://localhost:3000/dashboard but expected screen is the marketing landing page (route '/'). The test is navigating to /dashboard instead of /.
issues.root_cause: The CURRENT URL is /dashboard — the landing page lives at apps/web/app/page.tsx (route '/'), not /dashboard. The QA test or navigation is pointing to the wrong route.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated 7 times and 'entire root will switch to client rendering'. This likely caused by dynamic date/time rendering (e.g., 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting or 'Thursday, April 16' date) being computed differently on server vs client.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx, the greeting ('Good evening') and/or the date ('Thursday, April 16') are computed using new Date() or Date-based logic directly during render without suppressing hydration mismatch, causing server/client HTML divergence.

issues.description: Failed to fetch RSC payload for /dashboard after Fast Refresh — 'Falling back to browser navigation'. Transient network error during hot reload, but indicates possible instability in the dashboard route's server component.
issues.root_cause: Server component in apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx may be doing async work that times out or throws during Fast Refresh cycles, combined with the hydration errors causing root to switch to client rendering.

fixes.reason: Prevents server/client mismatch by returning a stable default on the server side, avoiding hydration errors from time-dependent greeting text.

fixes.old_str: const formattedDate = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
fixes.new_str: const formattedDate = typeof window === 'undefined' ? '' : new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
fixes.reason: Returns empty string on server to avoid hydration mismatch for the date display, which changes based on when server vs client renders.
